um
i guess
it was
in november
i was very depressed and suicidal
so i told my friend
what i was feeling

i don't know i guess go home or get sent to a mental hospital

um
<exhale> it was awful

it was scary

i had been so depressed for like a month i stopped going to my classes and work and i told my teachers lies

i was

it was
